why: Non-liquidation fee/revenue release class (2026-11-08 beyond-liquidations: fee/revenue auctions). Live on all three farm chains (github Uniswap/protocol-fees). Census 2026-11-09 run 3f440536: ethereum 1540 releases since 2025-12-30, 4.4/day over the last 31 d, 85 recipients; base 543 since ~2026-07-23 (mostly the launch backlog), 8 in the last 30 d (bursty), 13 recipients in the last 150; arbitrum 277, 37/30 d, 24 recipients. Trace economics: ETH tx 0xd7a72881 (winner 0x396a94, zero-inventory, buys 4000 UNI in the tx): surplus ~0.04 ETH, 90% bid to builder Titan = saturated. ARB tx 0xe91d4d5f (winner 0xf697c9ed): zero-inventory, Morpho flash 10 WETH, buys 2000 UNI in the tx from 3 pools, final profit 0.0019 ETH (~4 USD) = saturated. BASE tx 0xf0346087 (0x42914525, block 54990764): payout +6.516 ETH gross (fork pre/post balance reads) against 2000 UNI = 6.27 ETH at 9-day-old Chainlink prices, so net ~0.24 ETH; second Base tx 0xd58f86f2 net ~0.19 ETH. CAVEAT: a 4% UNI/ETH move erases that Base margin, and the zero-inventory Arbitrum and ETH winners make ~0, so the Base margin is likely an artifact of the stale price until it is recomputed at the block's price. Base incumbents hold 2000-UNI inventory (~14k USD, over X). Full detail: wiki infra/uniswap-fee-releaser.md
